name: cable kneeling shoulder internal rotation
description: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm inward. It builds rotator cuff strength and shoulder stability.
instructions: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the near hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm inward across your belly.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
